title: Rounding Off to the Nearest 5, 10, 100, 1 000, 10 000, 100 000 and 1 000 000
seo_title: Grade 6 Rounding Off Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_text: Round off to the nearest 5, 10, 100 and 1 000; use a range of techniques to perform and check written and mental calculations, including estimation and rounding off.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 6 rounding off worksheets: round to the nearest 5, 10, 100, 1 000 and bigger places, and rounding problems. 100 questions with memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Find the two multiples the number lies between and choose the nearer one.
  • Look at the digit to the right of the rounding place: 5 or more, round up; less than 5, round down.
  • All the digits to the right of the rounding place become 0.
  • Rounding off helps to estimate answers.

Examples

Example

Round 4 762 381 to the nearest 100 000

between 4 700 000 and 4 800 000

ten thousands digit 6

Answer: 4 800 000

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Rounding 5 down5 or more rounds up.
The wrong digitLook one place to the right.
Digits left behindEverything to the right becomes 0.

faq.q: What does CAPS Grade 6 say about rounding?
faq.a: Round off to the nearest 5, 10, 100 and 1 000, and use rounding to estimate.

faq.q: What is 2 649 999 to the nearest million?

faq.a: To estimate and check answers quickly.

items.q: Round 2 450 000 to the nearest 100 000.
items.e: 2 450 000 is exactly halfway between 2 400 000 and 2 500 000. A number that is exactly halfway rounds up. Answer: 2 500 000.

items.q: Round 3 500 000 to the nearest 1 000 000.
items.e: 3 500 000 is exactly halfway between 3 000 000 and 4 000 000. A number that is exactly halfway rounds up. Answer: 4 000 000.

items.q: A pumpkin at the autumn fair has a mass of 4,68 kg. What is its mass to the nearest tenth of a kilogram?
items.e: 4,68 is between 4,6 and 4,7. Look at the hundredths digit: 8. 5 or more, so round up to 4,7. 4,6 kg just cuts off the 8. Answer: 4,7 kg.

items.q: In gym class, Ethan ran 100 m in 14,37 seconds. What is his time to the nearest tenth of a second?
items.e: 14,37 is between 14,3 and 14,4. Look at the hundredths digit: 7. 5 or more, so round up to 14,4. Answer: 14,4 s.

items.q: At the 2 021 census, Québec City had a population of 549 459. What is this rounded to the nearest hundred thousand?
items.e: 549 459 is between 500 000 and 600 000. Look at the ten thousands digit, one place to the right of the hundred thousands: 4. 4 or less, so round down. Do not round twice (549 459 → 550 000 → 600 000). Answer: 500 000 people.

items.q: Priya jumped 3,475 m in the long jump at the track meet. What is this to the nearest hundredth of a metre?
items.e: 3,475 is exactly halfway between 3,47 and 3,48. A number that is exactly halfway rounds up. Answer: 3,48 m.

items.q: Four swimmers raced 50 m. Which time does not round to 36,5 s to the nearest tenth?
items.e: Times from 36,45 s up to (but not including) 36,55 s round to 36,5 s. 36,44 has 4 hundredths, so it rounds down to 36,4 s.

items.q: Anika’s 400 m time, rounded to the nearest tenth, is 52,3 seconds. Which could be her real time?
items.e: Times from 52,25 s to 52,34 s round to 52,3 s. 52,26 s is in that range. 52,36 s and 52,35 s round up to 52,4 s, and 52,21 s rounds down to 52,2 s.

items.q: The population of a town, rounded to the nearest ten thousand, is 250 000. What is the least the population could be?
items.e: Numbers from 245 000 to 254 999 round to 250 000. 244 999 would round down to 240 000, so the least is 245 000. (254 999 is the greatest.)

items.q: A race time rounded to the nearest tenth is 12,7 s. The real time was measured to the hundredth. What is the least it could be?
items.e: Times from 12,65 s to 12,74 s round to 12,7 s. 12,64 s would round down to 12,6 s, so the least is 12,65 s. (12,74 s is the greatest.)

items.q: Round 384 995 to the nearest 10.
items.e: 384 995 is exactly halfway between 384 990 and 385 000. A number that is exactly halfway rounds up. The tens digit is 9, so rounding up makes 10 tens. Exchange them for 1 hundred: 384 990 + 10 = 385 000. Answer: 385 000.

items.q: Round 39 960 to the nearest 100.
items.e: 39 960 is between 39 900 and 40 000. Look at the tens digit: 6. 5 or more, so round up. The hundreds digit is 9, so rounding up makes 10 hundreds. Exchange them for 1 thousand: 39 900 + 100 = 40 000. Answer: 40 000.

items.q: Round 499 600 to the nearest 1 000.
items.e: 499 600 is between 499 000 and 500 000. Look at the hundreds digit: 6. 5 or more, so round up. The thousands digit is 9, so rounding up makes 10 thousands. Exchange them for 1 ten thousand: 499 000 + 1 000 = 500 000. Answer: 500 000.

items.q: Which number rounds to 250 000 when you round to the nearest 10 000?
items.e: Numbers from 245 000 to 254 999 round to 250 000. 246 300 is in that range. 255 000 rounds to 260 000.

items.q: Which number rounds to 700 000 when you round to the nearest 100 000?
items.e: Numbers from 650 000 to 749 999 round to 700 000. 658 000 is in that range. 750 000 rounds to 800 000.

items.q: Which number rounds to 40 000 when you round to the nearest 1 000?
items.e: Numbers from 39 500 to 40 499 round to 40 000. 39 620 is in that range. 40 500 rounds to 41 000.

items.q: Which number rounds to 100 000 when you round to the nearest 10 000?
items.e: Numbers from 95 000 to 104 999 round to 100 000. 96 500 is in that range. 105 000 rounds to 110 000.
